description: Ministry of Higher Education Technology and Innovations - Degree Awarding Institute orders National School of Business Management Limited and 3 others
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the Minister of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation exercising powers under the Universities Act to amend degree programs and recognition conditions for private educational institutions. While it mentions a minister by name, the core content is about regulatory amendments to educational qualifications and institutional recognition under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
